items.Sentence: conveyed by gravity to an 86,000-gallon capacity, baffled septic tank where primary sedimentation occurs
the primary-treated wastewater flows by gravity to a wet well, where it mixes with circulating wastewater from sand/gravel filter beds
distributes the wastewater to the sand/gravel filter beds
the wastewater is pumped to a dosing structure, which distributes the wastewater to the sand/gravel filter beds
flows over a V-notch weir into a contact chamber, where it is chlorinated and then dechlorinated with sodium metabisulfite
Settled sludge in the septic tank is removed approximately every five years and hauled to an offsite septage tank receiving station for treatment and disposal
